{{Quote|Always open! Bounty never sleeps!|Bounty Emporium's slogan|<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-trivia-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref>}}
'''Bounty Emporium''' was a business located in the settlement of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Missing">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref> Another business with the same name and logo operated on the planet [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]]. Signage at the [[Orondia station]] said "Bounty Emporium"<ref name="Friends">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref> : "Always open!" : "[[Bounty/Legends|Bounty]] never [[Sleep/Legends|sleeps]]!".<ref name="Trivia" />
